text:
Cock-a-doodle-doo,
here I am,
said the rooster
Hummingbird.

The rooster Hummingbird
had red feathers,
and his suit
was lovely plumage.

Cock-a-doodle-doo.
Get up, farmer,
for the sun
is on its way.

Cock-a-doodle-doo.

Get up, plowman,
wake with joy,
for day is coming.

Cock-a-doodle-doo.

Children of the village,
wake up with a cheer;
they are waiting for you at school.
The village needs no clock:
the rooster alarm clock will do.

translation.title: The Rooster Alarm Clock
